item.title: [SwiftHFR] status: on-hold apart from status: blocked; every blocked issue names its blocker

labels.name: origin: infra
labels.description: Repo, CI, tooling, process, orchestration or docs upkeep not tied to another origin

item.body:
### Summary

As the operator, I want `status: blocked` to mean "waits on something nameable that will end", and a separate `status: on-hold` for issues held by a decision (M5 not open, operator's call), so that I can see what is really stuck and a script can unblock the rest.

### Source

Belayline harness francoisgn/belayline-agentic-harness#63, merged in its PR #70 (`cead80d`): `templates/.github/labels.json`, `docs/METHODOLOGY.md` §4, ADR 0003 amendment 2026-11-11. The diagnostic of 2026-11-11 found 62 open `status: blocked` issues: 21 whose cited blockers are all closed (mostly M5 lots held by `M5_OPEN`) and 21 with no readable blocker.

### Scope

1. One PR on `dev-swift`, before any relabel:
   - `.github/labels.yml`: add `status: on-hold` and `status: needs-decision`, with the harness spelling, colour and description. SwiftHFR has no `needs-decision` yet; the harness status axis has six states.
   - `tooling/roadmap/hygiene.py` and its tests:
     - exactly one status;
     - never move `on-hold` by itself;
     - unblock `blocked` only when every blocker in `### Blocked by` is closed;
     - report a `blocked` issue that has no such section.
   - Every status reader (boards #166 and #324, roadmap, weekly deck counters): `on-hold` is its own state.
   - Docs: AGENTS.md §7, issue forms, roadmap and lot docs, and every `.md` that explains `blocked`, `Blocked by`, `unblock` or `M5_OPEN`.
2. Create the labels on GitHub.
3. A dry-run classification table of every open `status: blocked` issue, with one outcome per issue: `on-hold`, `blocked` with a fixed section, `ready` or `needs-decision`. The table goes to the operator.
4. After the operator's go: apply with a script, one status at every moment, editing issue bodies only in the `### Blocked by` section or the decision sentence.
5. Verify:
   - counts before and after;
   - zero issue with zero or several statuses;
   - zero `blocked` issue without a section, and zero with only closed blockers;
   - hygiene run twice changes nothing.

### Acceptance criteria

- [ ] PR merged, with labels.yml, hygiene.py, tests, readers and docs aligned on the harness wording.
- [ ] Both labels exist on GitHub.
- [ ] Classification table posted, and the operator's answers recorded.
- [ ] Relabel applied, and the verification counts posted.
